claim: A public employee who is demoted within weeks of testifying before a legislative committee on matters of public concern presents sufficient temporal proximity to survive summary judgment on a First Amendment retaliation claim. The court held that protected speech need not be the sole motivating factor, only a substantial one, in the adverse employment decision.
citation: Pellegrino v. Cuyahoga County Board of Elections, 78 F.3d 541 (6th Cir. 1996)
